description: Counter-scenario: the fitted long-run rate until 1 January 2030, then the constant slope fitted across all 2010-2016 surveys until 1 January 2050. A sensitivity case with stated rates, not a climate or storm scenario and not a forecast.

assumptions.source: recovery_trajectories M1 long-run rate b for the untreated plots, fitted to the 4 Dec 2010 to 5 Oct 2016 surveys (1.4338, rounded to 0.01 m/yr; docs/V5_4_RECOVERY_VIEW.md)
owner: illustrative change date for the sensitivity case

recovery_trajectories M0 full-period fitted constant slope for the untreated plots: least-squares slope through the origin of plot increments at all surveys 4 Dec 2010 to 5 Oct 2016 (2.1933, rounded to 0.01 m/yr; includes the early excess). Not the endpoint average: 12.1256 m / 5.8363 yr = 2.08 m/yr
